summary: Observe live exec worker threads without blocking on an exited leader thread.

replay.detail: No replay or claim processing change; historical unknown process exit statuses are not backfilled.

schema.detail: Exec generation fields and stored formats remain unchanged.

rules.detail: Exec observation acquires only waitable owned-child statuses without blocking. A zombie main thread with live sibling threads keeps its process group running; owned exit status is still persisted once the process actually exits, including while descendants remain alive. No checkpoint or fleet admission rule changes.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or harness contract change. Owned and adopted execs preserve live worker liveness until actual process completion.

downtime.detail: No additional interruption beyond the normal binary update procedure.

manual.detail: No data conversion or extra operator step is required.

recovery.detail: Existing generation records remain readable; ordinary binary rollback remains available under existing state compatibility procedures.
